lines.ruling: Ruling: representation; project retained. The second leaves line 1 an input; the project figures it as the instructions direct for a filer who used the IRA Deduction Worksheet (person.ira_nondeductible): i8606 p. 9, Line 1, "subtract line 12 of the worksheet (or the amount you chose to deduct on Schedule 1 (Form 1040), line 20, if less) from the smaller of line 10 or line 11 of the worksheet". The other sources in the second's note are refused or the same: the Pub. 590-A worksheet (ira.kbh_short, ira.both_kinds), qualified reservist repayments (ira.special), the election to deduct less (ira.less_gate), and contributions with no deductible part, which the same subtraction gives with line 12 zero, contributions above the limit being refused (person.ira_over_limit, ira.over_comp).

Ruling: representation; project retained. Both take line 2 as the filer's amount: the project asks it (person.ira_basis) only of a person who files Form 8606 (person.ira_8606_line2), zero otherwise. i8606 p. 9, Line 2, "Generally, if this is the first year you are required to file Form 8606, enter -0-. Otherwise, use the Total Basis Chart". The wording of the project's question is a separate proposed finding, ruled in the render log for this line.

Ruling: representation; project retained. The project asks the question of each person (person.ira_dist) and shows the answer on the Form 8606 of a person who files it (f8606.dist, person.ira_dist_gate: nondeductible contributions and Yes); a Yes refuses line 14, and the deduction through person.ira_deduction, since lines 4 to 13 are not prepared. Form 8606 (2025), Part I, "In 2025, did you take a distribution from a traditional IRA, or make a Roth IRA conversion?" and "Go to line 4".
